# Spread Love & Acceptance (The Objective Ledger)

> Spread Love & Acceptance is a young, independent start-up building The Objective Ledger: a free, growing suite of self-help tools for understanding yourself and sharing life kindly with the people around you. It brings together practical relationship tools, gentle games, calm breathing and sound spaces, and a plain-language library, with new tools and content added all the time. Everything you type stays on your device.

Key facts:
- Website: https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/ . Free to use: every page, tool and chapter is open to everyone, with no sign-up, no account and no paid version. Email updates are optional.
- Who it is for: anyone who wants to understand themselves and get along more kindly and fairly with others: partners, families, co-parents, friends, roommates, coworkers and caregivers, and people exploring on their own.
- Themes: self-help, relationships, love, kindness, appreciation, acceptance, reconciliation and repair, calm, peace, harmony, breathing and quiet moments, connection, fairness and the invisible "mental load", and differences in how people are wired.
- The Five Pillars: see the whole load; fix the setup, not the person; read your state first; tune how you send and receive; notice the quiet incentives.
- Privacy: what people type into the tools stays on their own device.
- It is education and self-reflection, not therapy, diagnosis or treatment.
- Mascots: two pups, Tidbit (black mask) and Sugarfoot (white feet). Chat helper: Professor Puddles.
- Status: a young start-up with a working, growing suite; new tools and content are added continually (see https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/whats-new.html).
- Contact: patrick.christian.andrews@gmail.com

## Start here
- [Home](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/): Free self-help for calmer, fairer relationships: share chores and the mental load, check how a text lands, calm down and understand yourself. No sign-up.
- [About Spread Love & Acceptance and Its Creator](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/about.html): Meet Christian, the creator of Spread Love & Acceptance and The Objective Ledger: a career auditing systems, and a free, growing suite of kindness tools.
- [Contents: Every Free Tool, Guide and Chapter](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/contents.html): Everything in the program in three parts: tools for understanding yourself, tools for any two people, and where to start in your kind of relationship.
- [Every Free Guide, Tool and Worksheet, With Filters](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/explore.html): Every free page, guide, tool, worksheet, game and book chapter in one list. Filter by what you need, who it is about and how long you have. No sign-up.
- [Where to Start: Three Quick Questions, One Thing to Try](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/find-your-start.html): Answer three quick questions (who it is about, what is going on, how much time you have) and get one thing to try first and one short read. Free, private.
- [The Five Pillars of Fair, Kind Relationships](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/five-pillars.html): Five simple ideas for fair, kind relationships: see the whole mental load, fix the setup instead of the person, read your stress first, tune how you talk.
- [Glossary: The Words, in Plain English](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/glossary.html): Every word this site uses, from battery to talk window, in one plain sentence with an example, plus the older names some tools used to have.
- [How It Works: An Outside Look at Yourself](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/how-it-works.html): How the program works: a calm, outside view of your life situation, your wiring and what you notice, like an honest auditor with no verdict on your worth.
- [How You Take Things In: Make the Site Fit Your Mind](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/how-you-take-things-in.html): Pick how your mind takes things in, by neurotype (ADHD, autistic, dyslexic and more) or plain preferences, and every page adapts. Optional, on your device.
- [Is This Right for You? What It Is and Isn’t](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/is-this-for-you.html): A free self-help program for your own stress and reactions, and a fair way for two people to see what each carries at home. Education, not counseling.
- [Email Updates (Optional)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/membership.html): Everything on spreadloveandacceptance.com is free and open to everyone, with no account and no paid version. Email updates are optional.
- [Which part of the program to use](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/program.html): The program in one place: six gentle weeks, the Workpaper Suite, the package and report, the fill-in worksheets and the indexes, and which one to use when.
- [Relationship Tools for Couples, Families and Roommates](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/relationships.html): Free ways to share chores fairly, use kinder words and hold calmer check-ins, for couples, families, co-parents, friends, roommates, coworkers and carers.
- [Your Self-Discovery Path, Step by Step](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/self-path.html): The self-discovery path: understand your own load, rhythms and reactions first, with a few short worksheets and free tools you can use on your own.
- [Sent This by Someone? What They Can and Can’t See](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/sent-this.html): Someone sent you Spread Love & Acceptance? What they can and can’t see, what stays yours, and kind ways to say yes, not yet or no.
- [Someone Sent You This Link? No Pressure, Here’s What It Is](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/someone-sent-you-this.html): Someone sent you a link to Spread Love & Acceptance? What it is in three lines. You don’t have to do anything, and nothing you type leaves your phone.
- [Start Here: Fair Chores, Calm Talks, Kinder Relationships](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/start-here.html): New here? The one idea behind it all, the best free first tools, and a gentle six-week path to fairer chores, fewer fights and kinder talks at home.
- [Start in 10 Minutes: Four Small Steps](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/start-in-10-minutes.html): Four small steps, just for you or with someone: check your weather, read one short piece, notice your pattern, then pick one small change. No sign-up.
- [Free Relationship and Communication Tools, by Type](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/tools.html): Every free tool in one place, by type: communication, knowing yourself, sharing chores, calm and stress, family, work and games. No sign-up, no account.
- [Ways In: Everything Is Free and Open](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/ways-in.html): Everything here is free, with no account, no sign-up and no paid version. Email updates are optional.
- [Week 0: A Gentle Start to the Six Weeks](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/week-0.html): Five minutes before the six gentle weeks: what each week is, how long it takes, doing it alone or with anyone, and why missing a week is fine.
- [What’s new](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/whats-new.html): Everything newly added to the site, and everything that’s grown: new pages, new games, new sounds, and parts of the program that go deeper than before.
- [Why Use This Instead of an Article or an AI Chat?](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/why-this-site.html): What this free site does differently from articles and AI chats: agreements you both keep, both sides by design, private, and honest about its limits.

## Guides to common questions
- [How to Apologize So It Lands: The Apology Languages](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/apology-languages.html): The five apology languages as a menu of what makes a good apology, what research says works best, words to use and how to ask what helps. Free.
- [Appreciation at Work: How to Thank Coworkers Well](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/appreciation-at-work.html): Five ways people like to be thanked at work, as a menu not a label: words, time, help, small gifts and fitting gestures, with what research says. Free.
- [Bonding Ideas: How Closeness Grows, for Any Relationship](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/bonding.html): How closeness grows, from research on bids, responsiveness and play, plus a free idea picker for partners, kids, teens, friends, family and coworkers.
- [Calming Supplements for Anxiety: What Research Says](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/calming-supplements.html): Supplements, herbs, foods and practices for anxiety, stress, sleep and mood, graded honestly, with side effects, interactions and when to get help.
- [Chore Chart for Couples: How to Split Chores Fairly](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/chore-chart-for-couples.html): A free, printable chore chart for couples, families and roommates: list every job, including the invisible ones, give each an owner and review it weekly.
- [Communication Style Quiz: Find Your Wave Code (Free)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/communication-style-quiz.html): A free communication style quiz: find your four-letter Wave Code and which of 16 archetypes fits, from pace and detail to how you send and receive words.
- [Effective Communication: A Complete, Plain Guide](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/communication.html): A free, plain guide to effective communication: how to listen, say what you need, pick a good time, have hard talks and repair after a fight.
- [Complacency in Relationships: When “Fine” Goes Unchecked](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/complacency.html): Complacency isn’t laziness: it is what happens when something has worked for a long time and we stop looking. How to spot it, and small re-checks.
- [For Grandparents: Staying Close Without Taking Over](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/grandparents.html): Free, gentle help for grandparents: staying close when your grown child asks for space, sharing childcare fairly, house rules and saying no kindly.
- [Where Your Lens Came From: How Growing Up Shapes You](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/growing-up.html): How growing up shapes the adult you are: the big question at each stage, why timing makes some experiences go deeper.
- [How to Stop Fighting With Your Partner: 7 Calm Steps](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/how-to-stop-fighting-with-your-partner.html): Calm, practical ways to stop fighting with your partner: notice the early signs, take a real pause, check your words and fix what keeps causing fights.
- [Mental Load and Invisible Labor: How to Share It Fairly](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/invisible-labor-mental-load.html): What the mental load and invisible labor are, real examples from home life, and five calm steps to share the planning and remembering fairly. Free.
- [Love, Apology and Appreciation Languages, Together](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/languages-of-connection.html): Love languages, apology languages, touchstones, appreciation at work and your wiring, in one picture: six layers from you outward, and where to start.
- [Living Alone: Loneliness, Friends and a Home for One](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/living-alone.html): Free, kind help for living on your own at any age: alone versus lonely, a home for one, making friends as an adult, asking for help and weekends.
- [Love Languages: What the Research Says, and How to Use Them](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/love-languages.html): The five love languages as a menu, not a label: what research says, healthy and unhealthy versions of each, and how to ask for care in specifics. Free.
- [How to Calm Your Nervous System, in Plain Words](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/nervous-system.html): How your nervous system works: the stress response, fight, flight and freeze, the window of tolerance, the vagus nerve, and what helps you settle.
- [Neurodivergent Relationships: ADHD and Autistic Couples](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/neurodivergent-relationships.html): Practical tips for ADHD, autistic and AuDHD couples and families: communication differences, sensory overload at home, plans, chores and kind feedback.
- [New Relationship Advice: Dating, Texting and Pace](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/new-relationship.html): Free, kind help for dating at any age: texting and pace, a difference or a real concern, the big questions, meeting family, and ending it kindly.
- [Small Wins, and Turning Hard Feelings Into Fuel](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/small-wins.html): Why small wins build momentum, and kind ways to turn anger, worry and complaints into requests and plans. With a free Flip it tool and a done list.
- [Blended Families and Stepfamilies: Going Slowly Together](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/stepfamily.html): Free help for stepfamilies: the stepparent role, kids feeling torn, two homes with different rules, step and half siblings, money and holidays.
- [Touchstones: Shared Words, Jokes and Rituals That Bond](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/touchstones.html): The small shared words, jokes, rituals and stories that say “we are us”: how to notice them, keep them fresh and make new ones. For couples and families.

## Tools for kinder conversations and fair relationships
- [Ask Professor Puddles: Free, Private Relationship Help Chat](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/ask.html): Tell a cheerful raindrop professor what’s going on: kind next steps, words to say, deep talks and infographics.
- [Carrier Wave Decoder: When a Talk Starts to Go Wrong](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/carrier-wave-decoder.html): A guided, step-by-step tool for the moment a conversation starts going sideways: check your state, get back in tune, and look back on the week together.
- [Relationship Check-In: A Kind Weekly Talk for Couples](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/check-ins.html): A short, kind weekly check-in for couples, families and housemates: what went well, what felt heavy, and one small change to try next week. Free.
- [Text Conversation Analyzer: Calm Replies After a Fight](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/conversation-reader.html): Paste a text thread after a fight and see where it turned, what each of you may be hearing, and calmer replies built from your own words. Free and private.
- [The Full Path Package and Report](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/full-path.html): One fillable PDF with every workpaper for your road, and a detailed report written from your answers: findings, things worth a second look.
- [Know Your Own Wiring: A Self-Discovery Guide](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/know-yourself.html): Why you react the way you do: your wiring, what life taught you and what is just today, plus kind words to explain what helps to the people around you.
- [Chore and Bill Tracker: Who Does What at Home](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/lemonade-stand.html): A free tracker for chores, bills and family money, for one person or a whole home: see who does and pays what, and talk it over without blame. No sign-up.
- [30-Day Look-Back: What Shifted in Who Does What](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/look-back-30-days.html): Four weeks of who did what, last-minute rescues and jobs with an owner, side by side: what shifted, what didn’t, and one next step. Free, on your device.
- [See It From Their Side: A Free Perspective-Taking Tool](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/perspective-shifter.html): Step into the other person’s side of a moment: their day, their wiring, what they could see and what they could not. A free, private tool.
- [Daily Mood Check-In and Stress Check: Today’s Weather](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/quick-checks.html): A one-minute daily mood check-in and stress check: how you are doing today, a gentle forecast for hard talks.
- [Text Tone Checker: How Will My Message Land?](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/signal-translator.html): Worried a text sounds rude or cold? See how it may land and what they may hear, then get a clearer version that keeps your ask. Free, private, no sign-up.
- [A 2-Minute Snapshot of How Your Household Shares the Load](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/snapshot/): A gentle two-minute look at how the shared load is set up at home and how it bends, for couples, families, roommates and teams. Not a test or a diagnosis.
- [The 2-minute snapshot](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/snapshot/snapshot-diagnostic-snapshot-interactive.html): Seven quick questions about how a shared load is set up and how it bends under pressure. You get one of four areas, the scoring shown openly.
- [Are Your Rhythms in Step? Frequency Calibration](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/tools/frequency-calibration.html): A worksheet for two people to map their rhythms for money, rest, decisions, check-ins and recovery, and see where they match and where they drift apart.
- [Frequency Sync Visualizer](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/tools/frequency-sync-visualizer.html): A calm picture of two rhythms drifting into step: the idea behind the 90-second daily check-in (WP-13).
- [Soften a Tense Moment, Level 2: The Full Toolkit](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/tools/soften-a-tense-moment-full.html): Level 2 of “Soften a tense moment”: a plan builder that turns your state, their state, the situation and the relationship into a printable plan, plus five.
- [Soften a Tense Moment, Level 1: The Introduction](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/tools/soften-a-tense-moment.html): Level 1 of “Soften a tense moment”: settle yourself first, read the state someone else is in (wound up, shut down or scattered).
- [Turning Toward: 7 Small Habits for Closer Relationships](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/turning-toward.html): Connection grows in small moments. Seven simple habits for love and appreciation: notice when someone reaches for you, say specific thanks, repair gently.
- [Wavelength: A 2-Minute Quiz on How You Talk and Listen](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wavelength.html): A free two-minute quiz on how you like to talk and listen. Get your four-letter Wave Code, compare it with someone and make a card for work. Free.
- [Wired Differently: Neurodiversity and Communication](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wired-differently.html): How ADHD, autistic and other differently wired minds can hear the same words differently, and simple ways to share plans, chores and feedback that land.
- [Wiring Card: A One-Page “How I Communicate” Card](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wiring-card.html): Make a free one-page card on how you take in words, what your silence means and how a request lands best, to share at home or at work. No sign-up.
- [Talk It Through in Writing: Write It, Wait, Then Send](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/write-it-through.html): A calm, private way to sort something out in writing: one topic, facts not verdicts, one clear ask and a reply-by time. Write it, wait, then send it.

## Worksheets (the Workpaper Suite)
- [Try the workpapers](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/do/): A practice space to try the core worksheets on a worked example before you use your own week. Nothing is saved.
- [Workpaper Playground](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/do/workpaper-playground.html): Practice the core worksheets on a worked example: log a week (WP-01), check a battery (WP-02), name owners (WP-03) and see if the load can last (CALC-01).
- [A Six-Week Guided Program for Fairer Chores](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/prog-01.html): Six gentle weeks, one worksheet a week: see the mental load, give every chore an owner, check your stress and how you talk, then look at what has changed.
- [Program Overview](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/program-overview.html): How the program fits together: the chapters explain the ideas and the worksheets put them to use.
- [Suite Index](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/suite-index.html): The official list of what’s built today. If something is listed here, it’s live and ready to use. If it isn’t listed, it isn’t live yet.
- [Is the Setup Working for Everyone? A Fair-Split Calculator](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/calculators/is-the-setup-working-quick.html): Type in the totals from your chore worksheets, for 2 to 8 people, and see in plain words whether the way you share the load works for everyone.
- [Look Back Over 30 Days: What Shifted, What Didn’t](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/calculators/look-back-30-days-quick.html): Type in how things were a month ago and how they are this week: who did what, rescues, load and owners. Get a plain read of what shifted and one next step.
- [Your progress, week by week (REPORT-01)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/report-01.html): One place to type in what your worksheets produced each week, and a report that reads them side by side to show where they agree and where they don’t.
- [Who Did What: A One-Week Chore Log and Kind Ways to Say No](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-01.html): A one-week log of who did what at home, plus three calm ways to say no or “not right now” without a fight. A free worksheet for couples and roommates.
- [Stress Check: How Much Are You Carrying? (WP-02)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-02-how-much-are-you-carrying.html): A five-question stress check that separates how much you are already carrying from how upset you are about one thing. A reflection tool, not a test.
- [One Owner per Job: A Free Household Chore Agreement](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-03-one-owner-per-job.html): Give every recurring household chore one clear owner from start to finish, so nothing slips, nobody nags and you stop re-deciding who does what each week.
- [What Keeps Coming Back? Find the Chores That Keep Slipping](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-04-what-keeps-coming-back.html): Once a month, look back at four weeks of chore logs together, find the jobs and arguments that keep coming back.
- [Say It So It Lands: Kinder Words Before You Reply](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-09-say-it-so-it-lands.html): A quick self-check before you answer something that landed hard, so what you say next is calm, clear and something the other person can actually hear.
- [Same Moment, Different Speeds: A Worksheet for Two](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-12-same-moment-different-speeds.html): One of you wants to sort it now, the other needs time. A free worksheet to map each person’s speed in five everyday moments and agree one small fix.
- [90-Second Daily Check-In for Couples and Housemates](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-13-daily-check-in.html): A 90-second daily check-in: one sentence each about how you are doing and what is coming up, so small things do not pile up into a weekend argument. Free.
- [Is It Us, or Everything Else? A Stress Log for Two](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-14-is-it-us-or-everything-else.html): Snapping at each other lately? A free one-week log that separates outside pressure (work, money, sleep, illness) from friction between you, with a plan.
- [Keep Your Little Rituals Alive: A Check for Couples](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/workpapers/wp-15-keep-your-little-rituals-alive.html): The Sunday walk, the morning coffee, the goodnight text. A free 15-minute check, every few months, on which shared rituals are alive, fading or stopped.
- [Calm-Down Sounds: Brown Noise, a Low Hum and More](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wp-11-sound-toolkit.html): Three simple background sounds to try as part of your calm-down plan: a low hum, a soft flutter and brown noise.
- [Calm-Down Kit: A Plan for Heated Moments](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/wp-11.html): Make a short plan on a calm day: your early signs, two calming steps and a pause line with a time to come back. Free, no sign-up, on your device.

## Calm, breathing and sound
- [The Bears Dojo: A Calm Temple Garden to Wander Into](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/bears-dojo.html): Wander a quiet temple garden where Tidbit and Sugarfoot tend the grounds, build your own bear, then step inside for gentle things to do.
- [Drift: Calm Visuals and Soft Tones to Unwind](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/calm-visualizer.html): Tell Drift how you feel, put on headphones, and let slow, dreamy visuals, kind words and gentle tones keep you company for a few quiet minutes of calm.
- [Echoes of Gold — The Companion Album](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/echoes-of-gold.html): Echoes of Gold (The Christian Project): the 11-track album that came before The Objective Ledger, produced by Christian, performing as Loves Journey EP.
- [The Night Garden: A Calm Breathing Exercise Game](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/night-garden.html): A breathing exercise you can play: breathe slowly to make flowers bloom, guide fireflies into constellations and stack glowing stones.
- [Pal Cam TV: A Cozy Cartoon Puppy Cam for Your TV](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/pal-cam-tv.html): Leave two cartoon pups playing and napping on your TV all day, with calm music and light that follows the time of day. Free, no sign-up, ready to cast.
- [Brain Breakers: Instrumental Music with a Visualizer](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/soundscapes.html): Four instrumental pieces by Christian’s Lab, from soft and floating to big and cinematic, with a media-player-style music visualizer and gentle vibration.

## Calm games
- [Daily Crossword Puzzle, Newspaper Style (Free)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/daily-ledger-crossword.html): A free newspaper-style daily crossword with fair, friendly clues, from a quick 5x5 mini to a big Sunday grid.
- [Tidbit and Sugarfoot’s Arcade: Five Calm Classic Games](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/frequency-journey.html): Play as Tidbit or Sugarfoot in five gentle classic games: a maze chase, a road-and-river crossing, a wagon-trail journey.
- [Calm Games for a Busy Mind: Free, No Timers](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/pause-and-play.html): Free calm games with no timers and no way to lose: the Night Garden breathing game, the Frequency Journey, Word Bloom, crosswords and a cozy word search.
- [The Quest Map](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/quest.html): A friendly map of the whole program, grouped by the Five Pillars. Each chapter, workpaper, guide, tool, game and library shelf lights up as you explore it.
- [Quiet Crossword: Easy, Gentle Mini Crosswords](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/quiet-crossword.html): Small, friendly mini crosswords with gentle clues in five levels from easy to tricky. Free and calm with no timer.
- [Calm Word Search, No Timer: Quiet Words (Free)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/quiet-words.html): A calm, free word search with soft themes, levels from easy to tricky and no timer. Every word you find leaves a kind thought behind.
- [The Re-check Drive: A Calm Football Game](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/recheck-drive.html): A calm football game with no clock and no way to lose. Do the small, kind re-checks from the complacency playbook for real.
- [Word Bloom: A Relaxing Letter-Wheel Word Game](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/word-bloom.html): A free, relaxing word game: swipe across a wheel of letters to find the hidden words. Hundreds of levels from easy to tricky, with no timers and no ads.

## Help for your situation
- [When a Child Has ADHD: For Parents and Grandparents](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/adhd-kids.html): Plain, free help when a child has ADHD: it is real, not bad behaviour. Words for fidgeting and forgetting, one instruction at a time, routines and screens.
- [Find It by Relationship: Every Page, Sorted by Who It’s For](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/by-relationship.html): Every page on the site in one list, sorted by who it’s for: just you, couples, friends, family, co-parents, roommates, work, life changes.
- [Caregiver Support: Help for Caring for Someone You Love](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/caregivers.html): Free, practical help for caregivers: when the person can’t share the load back, how to ask family for specific help, and where to find respite.
- [Co-Parenting After Separation: Calmer Handoffs and Texts](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/co-parenting.html): Calmer co-parenting after a separation: an exchange-day script, keeping kids out of the middle, a tone check for texts, and a parallel-parenting route.
- [Coming Home After Time Apart: Deployment and Work Away](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/coming-home.html): Free help for the first weeks after a deployment, work away or a hospital stay: a handover week, finding your place again, the kids.
- [Coming Out as an Adult: Family, Work and Partners](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/coming-out.html): Free help for coming out as an adult: your timing, safety and money first, words for parents, if they cut you off, at work, with a partner, and support.
- [Different Hours: Night Shifts, Shift Work and Time Together](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/different-hours.html): Free help when you work different hours: night shifts and recovery sleep count as work, protected sleep.
- [Empty Nest: When the House Is Quiet Between You](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/empty-nest.html): Free help in plain English for couples whose children have grown and left home: small daily habits, care shown by doing, and questions to ask each other.
- [Ayuda en español: familia, pareja y tareas de la casa](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/en-espanol.html): Ayuda gratis en español: hijos que pelean, gritos, enojo, cuidar a un ser querido, cuando haces todo en la casa, niños pequeños y si no estás a salvo.
- [Supporting Family: Parents, Money Home and Duty](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/family-obligations.html): Free, even-handed help for couples who support parents and family: agree a monthly family-support amount, lead with your own family, and save alongside it.
- [Family Rifts Between Adult Siblings: Reaching Out](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/family-rifts.html): Free, fair help for family rifts between grown siblings: after a loss, a will or years of silence. Short first messages, and kind ways to say “not yet”.
- [For Counselors, Coaches and Group Leaders](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/for-counselors.html): For therapists, counselors, coaches and group leaders: what this free self-help site is and isn’t, its safety screen, evidence status, and homework tools.
- [Foster, Adoptive and Kinship Families: Help for Carers](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/foster-and-kinship.html): Free, kind help for foster carers, adoptive parents and relatives raising a child: testing behaviour, one approach, house rules and contact visits.
- [Friends: When a Friendship Drifts](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/friends.html): Free, kind help when a friendship drifts: for the friend who always reaches out and the one who went quiet after a baby or a hard year.
- [Gaming, Phones and Time Together](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/gaming-and-time-together.html): Fair, free help when one of you games or scrolls a lot: heads-ups, bids between matches, a protected evening.
- [Grief and Loss: Help for Families and a New Chapter](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/grief.html): Gentle, free help after a loss: grieving differently in one family, reconnecting with grown children, starting a new chapter, and where to get support.
- [For Grown-Up Children: Boundaries With a Parent You Love](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/grown-up-children.html): Free, kind help for grown-up children: ask a parent to text before visiting, handle unasked-for advice, the new baby, in-laws and holidays.
- [Where Am I Right Now? A Nervous System Ladder Check](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/ladder.html): Four quick taps show if you’re calm and connected, revved up or running on empty, with what helps right now, a pause line to say and when to talk again.
- [Long-Distance and Apart: Staying Close Across the Miles](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/long-distance.html): Free, practical help for couples living apart: time zones, check-ins on video, a call rhythm you agree, small bids, short texts, and visits and goodbyes.
- [Money Together: Different Styles, One Plan](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/money-together.html): Free, fair help for couples with different money styles: personal money for each, a shared check-in limit, moving in, wedding costs, and limits vs control.
- [More Than Two Partners at Home](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/more-than-two.html): Free help for triads and homes with more than two partners: share the planning, join a home that ran before you.
- [New Baby: How New Parents Can Share the Load](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/new-parent.html): A three-step way for new parents to split the baby jobs and the invisible ones: list every job, give each one owner, and review it ten minutes a week.
- [On My Own After a Breakup or Divorce](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/on-my-own.html): Free, gentle help after a breakup or divorce: the first weeks, loneliness, money, rebuilding a life, and part-time parenting when the kids are with you.
- [Parenting Help: Big Feelings, Sibling Fights, Calm Kids](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/parents.html): Free, gentle help for parents: name big feelings, calm sibling fights, simple calm-down routines for kids, talking with teens, and a cartoon to watch.
- [One of You Wants to Talk Now, the Other Needs Space](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/pursue-withdraw.html): Even-handed help when one partner wants to talk now and the other needs space: why it hurts on both sides, and a pause plan to fill in and share. Free.
- [How to Say No Kindly: Polite Refusal Scripts](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/refusals.html): Pick a situation and a tone, and get three kind, copy-ready ways to say no: “I’m full today”, “Not me, but let’s find who” or “Yes, just later”. Free.
- [Retired and Both Home Now: Sharing the House Again](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/retired-together.html): Free, practical help when retirement puts you both at home all day: territory and routines, re-dividing whole jobs, handing over kindly.
- [Not safe at home?](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/safety.html): If someone hurts, threatens, watches or controls you: free hotlines, a quick way to leave this site, and how to clear what it keeps.
- [How to Share Household Chores Fairly, Step by Step](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/share-the-load.html): When it feels like you do everything at home: name every job, see the split in plain numbers, give each job one owner and review it. Free, no sign-up.
- [Roommate Agreement and Chores for a Dorm or Flat](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/sharing-a-room.html): Free, calm help for sharing a dorm room or flat: a roommate agreement, cleaning, quiet hours, guests, borrowing, and talking to your RA. No sign-up.
- [For Teens: When Home, Friends and Feelings Get Loud](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/teens.html): Free, private help for teens: getting along with parents or carers, a parent who is away, friend drama, big feelings, healthy dating, and help fast.
- [Two Faiths or Cultures, One Family](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/two-faiths.html): Fair help for interfaith and mixed-culture families: decide names, rituals and upbringing together, tell both families, and plan festivals on one calendar.
- [Upset Right Now? How to Calm Down Together, Fast](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/upset-right-now.html): A five-minute page for upset people: a pause line with a return time, a one-minute breathing pacer, and steps for a parent about to yell. Also in Spanish.
- [When One of You Is Ill or Disabled: Share by Energy](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/when-one-is-ill.html): Free help for couples when one partner lives with a chronic illness or disability: share the load by energy, not hours, plan for bad days.
- [Workplace Communication: Fair Workloads, Kind Messages](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/work.html): Free, plain tools for teams: one owner per job, messages that land, appreciation that fits, and a 45-minute team session. No sign-up, no cartoons.

## The book, Part Three: Understanding people
- [Chapter 1: How Feelings Work, and Naming What You Feel](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/understanding-1-feelings.html): How feelings work: signals from the body, why naming a feeling helps, layers and waves, and kind words to use alone, at home, with friends and at work.
- [Chapter 2: Stress, Flooding, Rest and Recovery](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/understanding-2-stress.html): How stress works: your body getting ready, the calm, revved up and running on empty ladder, flooding, why stress adds up, and the rest that helps.
- [Chapter 3: How We See Each Other: Perception and Bias](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/understanding-3-seeing.html): Why perception is a best guess, the stories we fill gaps with, everyday bias, us and them, and how to see people more fairly by asking, not guessing.
- [Chapter 4: How Communication Works: Listening and Repair](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/understanding-4-communication.html): How communication works: why meaning is made between two people, listening, checking, saying hard things kindly, repairing mix-ups and messages that land.
- [Attachment, Trust and Belonging: Chapter 5](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/understanding-5-belonging.html): Why belonging is a basic need, how early bonds shape what we expect, how trust grows in small moments, and how to rebuild it and find your people. Free.
- [Chapter 6: Habits and Change: How Small Steps Work](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/understanding-6-change.html): Why change is hard, how habits run on cues, and how tiny steps, a kinder setup and self-compassion after slips help change last, alone or with others.
- [Chapter 7: Self-worth, shame and self-compassion](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/understanding-7-worth.html): Why worth is not a score, how shame differs from guilt, what the inner critic is for, and how self-compassion helps you own mistakes and grow. Free.
- [Chapter 8: Loss, grief and big life changes](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/understanding-8-loss.html): How grief works: waves not stages, grief in the body, losses nobody sees, staying connected to who you lost, big life changes, and how to help. Free.
- [Chapter 9: Minds that work differently](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/understanding-9-minds.html): A plain guide to neurodiversity: autism, ADHD, sensory and learning differences, masking and energy, and how to meet in the middle at home and work.
- [Chapter 10: Values, meaning and a good life](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/understanding-10-values.html): What values are, how to find yours, what to do when two good things clash, and what old philosophy offers a busy, ordinary life today.
- [Chapter 11: Healing after hurt](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/understanding-11-healing.html): How hurt heals: repair after small ruptures, apologies that land, what forgiveness is and is not, rebuilding trust, and when to get more help.
- [Chapter 12: Helping others well](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/understanding-12-helping.html): How to help without taking over: ask what help is wanted, listen first, keep kind limits, help in a crisis, and look after yourself so you last.
- [Anger: What It’s For and What to Do, Chapter 13](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/understanding-13-anger.html): What anger is for, what it does in the body, steps for the hot minutes, why venting backfires, how to repair, and when anger becomes harm.
- [Personality and Temperament: Chapter 14](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/understanding-14-personality.html): Personality as dials, not boxes: the Big Five, temperament, introverts and extraverts, how people change with age, and living with different people.
- [Closeness and Love: How Intimacy Grows, Chapter 15](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/understanding-15-love.html): How closeness grows: love in many forms, intimacy as being known, feeling understood, attachment in adult love, and love across ages and relationships.
- [Worry, Low Mood and Trauma: Chapter 16](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/understanding-16-worry.html): How worry and anxiety work, low mood versus depression, what trauma is and isn’t, what helps day to day, how to support someone, and where to get help.
- [Fitting In: Groups, Influence and Culture, Chapter 17](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/understanding-17-groups.html): Why fitting in pulls so hard: conformity, obedience, us and them, norms, family culture, groups online, and how to stay yourself and disagree kindly.

## The book
- [Afterword: What the Book Adds Up To](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/afterword.html): A short closing page: what Parts One to Three were for, six threads that run through the whole book, and where to go from here.
- [Chapter I: Why we get out of tune](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/chapter-1.html): Chapter I: why kind people still end up resentful at home, and how small mismatches in pace, tone and what we expect add up, plus how to get back in tune.
- [Chapter II: Is the split working?](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/chapter-2.html): Chapter II: a fair way to ask whether the division of labor at home is working for everyone, counting time, effort and the invisible jobs, never blame.
- [Chapter III: Full tanks and different angles](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/chapter-3.html): Chapter III: how a full stress tank changes what we hear and say, why the same moment looks different from each side, and how to pause before you react.
- [Chapter IV: Two kinds of fair](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/chapter-4.html): Chapter IV: equal and fair are not the same thing. How couples and families find a fair chore split that fits their real lives, strengths and seasons.
- [Chapter V: The monthly look-back](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/chapter-5.html): Chapter V: a calm monthly look-back for couples and households to see what changed, celebrate it, and adjust the setup before resentment builds up.
- [The Objective Ledger: The Book as Free PDFs](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/download.html): Free PDFs of the book, sent for an email address: the whole book, the book for one person, for two or more, or Understanding People, short or full.
- [The Book for One Person: Know Yourself, Understand People](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/for-yourself.html): Part One (yourself) and Part Three (understanding people) of the free book on one page: everything you can read and use on your own. No sign-up.
- [Free Self-Help Book Online: The Objective Ledger](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/): Read the whole self-help book free online: 26 chapters in three parts on yourself, sharing a life fairly and understanding people. No sign-up, no account.
- [Preface: The work nobody sees](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/preface.html): The Preface: the planning, remembering and noticing that keeps a home running, why this invisible work goes unseen, and how seeing it changes everything.
- [Know Yourself, Then: Where Your Lens Came From](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/self-1-then.html): Part One, Then: where your lens came from, how growing up shaped what you expect, and which old rules are worth keeping.
- [Know Yourself, Now: Your Wiring, Weather and Words](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/self-2-now.html): Part One, Now: how you are built, what kind of day you are having, and one clear sentence about what helps.
- [Know Yourself, Next: Shaping Who You Are Becoming](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/self-3-next.html): Part One, Next: what matters to you, one small goal, tiny steps for tired days and a kind monthly look at yourself.
- [The Book for Two or More: Sharing a Home Fairly](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/together.html): Part Two of the free book on one page: sharing a home, work or care fairly with partners, family, housemates, co-parents or coworkers. No sign-up.
- [The Book by Relationship: What to Read First](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/topic-by-relationship.html): Which parts of the book matter most for you: the best sections for couples, friends, family, siblings, co-parents, carers, housemates and work.
- [The Book on Staying Calm, Chapter by Chapter](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/topic-calm.html): Every part of the book about staying calm, made short: full tanks, what settles you, stepping out to retune and coming back, on your own or with others.
- [The Book on Knowing Yourself, Chapter by Chapter](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/topic-know-yourself.html): Every part of the book about knowing yourself, made short: your lens, your wiring, your weather, one small goal and leftover stress, on your own or with.
- [The Book on Sharing the Load at Home](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/topic-share-the-load.html): Every part of the book about sharing the work at home, cut down to just that: the work nobody sees, is the split working.
- [The Book at a Glance: Where to Start](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/topic-start-here.html): The whole book in short paragraphs, one per part and chapter, on your own or with others, with the best first steps and tools to start with.
- [The Book on Talking It Through](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/topic-talk-it-through.html): Every part of the book about talking kindly, cut down to just that: getting back in tune, reading your own state.
- [Understanding People: How Feelings, Stress and Trust Work](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/understanding.html): Part Three of the free book on one page: seventeen short chapters on how feelings, stress, trust, change, grief, anger and love work. No sign-up.
- [The Whole Book on One Page (Short Versions)](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/book/whole.html): Every chapter of The Objective Ledger, in order, on one page: read straight through, search it, or print it or save it as a PDF. Free, no sign-up.

## The Professor’s Library and further reading
- [The Frequency Framework: Getting Back in Step](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/frequency-framework.html): Two people can each run on their own rhythm for money, rest, decisions, talking and values.
- [Stories From Philosophy for Everyday Life](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/learn/): Twelve old stories from philosophy, retold in plain words, to help you know yourself, see the other person more clearly and live more kindly with others.
- [Relationship Psychology Library, in Plain English](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library.html): Hundreds of plain-language entries on relationships, conflict, kindness, gratitude, emotions, stress, calm and wiring, with honest notes on the evidence.
- [Calm and Attention, Explained](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/calm.html): What research says about calm and attention: breathing, mindfulness, nature, rest, mind-wandering and flow, with modest and honest claims about each one.
- [Communication in Relationships: Talking and Listening](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/communication.html): Plain-language research on communication in relationships: listening, asking, feedback, tone, apology and the everyday skills of being understood.
- [Conflict Resolution in Relationships, Explained](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/conflict.html): Plain-language research on conflict in relationships: why arguments escalate, how repair works, apology, forgiveness, mediation and fair process.
- [Kindness, Gratitude and Connection, Explained](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/connection.html): What research says about kindness, gratitude, appreciation and connection: small daily rituals, thanks that lands and the habits that keep people close.
- [Understanding Feelings and Emotions](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/emotions.html): Plain-language research on feelings and emotions: naming them, shame and guilt, anger, rumination, grief and resilience, with honest notes on the evidence.
- [The Mental Load and Fair Division of Labor at Home](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/fairness.html): What research says about the mental load, invisible work and the division of labor at home, why each person often thinks they do more, and what helps.
- [Family, Money and Big Life Changes](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/life.html): Plain-language research on family life, money talks, co-parents, holidays, in-laws and the big transitions of life, and how to share the load through them.
- [Motivation, Habits and Change, Explained](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/motivation.html): Plain-language research on motivation, habits and change: mindset, self-esteem, values, rewards and the small steps that help a new habit stick for good.
- [How Relationships Work: What Research Says](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/relationships.html): What research on couples, families and friends says about what keeps people close: attachment, trust, appreciation, repair and sharing the load at home.
- [Stress and the Body, in Plain English](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/stress.html): How stress shows up in the body and in relationships, in plain words: the stress response, polyvagal theory and its critics, sleep, hunger and burnout.
- [Fair Systems for Teams and Households](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/teams.html): How fair systems work for teams and households: clear owners, blameless reviews, checklists, and why shared jobs slip when everyone owns them at once.
- [Common Thinking Traps, Explained](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/thinking.html): Plain-language guides to common thinking traps: why we jump to conclusions, expect the worst, remember selectively and misread each other, and what helps.
- [Neurodiversity Explained: Autism, ADHD and Sensitivity](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/library/wiring.html): Plain-language entries on differences in wiring: autism, ADHD, the double empathy problem, high sensitivity, sensory overload, personality and chronotype.
- [Method and Limits: How the Scores Work](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/method-and-limits.html): The main scores on the site written out: how each one is worked out, the cut-offs, and what it cannot tell you.
- [Help Beyond This Site](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/outside-help.html): A short, trusted list of outside help: finding a counsellor in the US and UK, free helplines, support groups for families and carers.
- [The Polymath Way: How Every Field Connects](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/polymath.html): How psychology, economics, nature, music and more grow from the same few roots, and how a polymath joined thirteen fields into one program you can learn.
- [Further Reading](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/reading.html): Hand-picked articles from Psychology Today, Greater Good Magazine, The Gottman Institute and other trusted sources.
- [The Research Behind This Site, in Plain Words](https://spreadloveandacceptance.com/research.html): The studies, books and reviews behind this free self-help site: what each found, in plain words, how strong the evidence is, and a link to read more.
